promptEs: ¿Cómo cambió su opinión?
stimulusEn: I expected the novel to be slow, but the second half was so engaging that I finished it in one evening.
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: it became much more positive.

promptEs: ¿Cómo cambió su reacción?
stimulusEn: The course was demanding at first, especially the weekly presentations. By the end, however, I felt much more confident speaking in public.
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: from difficulty to greater confidence.

promptEs: ¿Qué beneficio menciona además de ahorrar dinero?
stimulusEn: I used to drive to work every day. Since I started cycling, I have more energy in the morning and I spend less on fuel.
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: having more energy.

promptEs: ¿Qué se puede inferir?
stimulusEn: The doctor did not prescribe antibiotics. She explained that the infection was viral and recommended rest and fluids.
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: antibiotics were not considered useful.

promptEs: ¿Qué ventaja compensa el menor tamaño?
stimulusEn: The flat is smaller than the other one, but it is close to work and the rent includes electricity.
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: location and included electricity.

promptEs: ¿Qué valora más el hablante?
stimulusEn: The new job pays slightly less, yet it offers flexible hours and better training. For me, those advantages matter more right now.
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: flexibility and training.

promptEs: ¿Qué se puede inferir?
stimulusEn: At first I thought the music came from the apartment upstairs, but it stopped as soon as the cafe across the street closed.
optionB: the cafe was probably the source
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: the cafe was probably the source.

promptEs: ¿Cómo está organizada la presentación?
stimulusEn: I will explain the problem first, then show the data, and finally discuss two possible solutions.
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: problem, evidence, then solutions.

promptEs: ¿De qué depende terminar el viernes?
stimulusEn: We can finish by Friday if the supplier delivers the parts tomorrow. Otherwise, we will need to move the deadline.
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: the supplier delivering tomorrow.

promptEs: ¿Qué solución encontró?
stimulusEn: Working remotely saves me commuting time, but I miss informal conversations with colleagues. I now go to the office twice a week.
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: a mixed home-and-office routine.

promptEs: ¿Qué causaba el problema?
stimulusEn: The technician said the battery was fine but the charging port was damaged. After replacing that part, the phone worked normally.
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: the charging port.

promptEs: ¿Cómo reaccionaron al retraso?
stimulusEn: Our flight was delayed for three hours. Instead of waiting at the gate, we used the time to finish some work at a quiet cafe.
optionA: they used the waiting time productively
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: they used the waiting time productively.

promptEs: ¿Qué cambio redujo la factura?
stimulusEn: Our electricity bill went up in winter, so we checked which appliances used the most power. The old heater was the main problem. We replaced it and the next bill was noticeably lower.
explanationEs: Interpretación objetivo: replacing the old heater.

promptEs: ¿Qué factor fue decisivo?
stimulusEn: The salary was not the main reason I accepted the job. The company offered six months of structured training and a mentor, which seemed more valuable at the beginning of my career.
explanationEs: Interpretación objetivo: training and mentoring.

promptEs: ¿Qué efecto positivo menciona?
stimulusEn: The council planted trees along the main road last year. Traffic has not decreased, but people say the street feels cooler in the afternoon and more pleasant to walk along.
optionA: a cooler and more pleasant street
explanationEs: Interpretación objetivo: a cooler and more pleasant street.

promptEs: ¿Qué cambió en su método?
stimulusEn: I used to reread my notes again and again. Now I test myself without looking at them and return to the material a few days later. It feels harder, but I remember much more.
optionA: from rereading to retrieval and spaced review
explanationEs: Interpretación objetivo: from rereading to retrieval and spaced review.

promptEs: ¿Qué beneficio apareció con el tiempo?
stimulusEn: At first the new meeting format felt too strict because everyone had only two minutes to speak. After a few weeks, however, we noticed that meetings were shorter and quieter colleagues contributed more often.
explanationEs: Interpretación objetivo: more efficient and balanced participation.

promptEs: ¿Qué ventaja tiene el tren?

explanationEs: Interpretación objetivo: it is usually faster and more predictable.

promptEs: ¿Cómo cambia su actitud?

promptEs: ¿Qué crítica implícita hace?
stimulusEn: The talk covered a great deal of material, perhaps more than could be absorbed in forty minutes.
optionA: the talk may have been too dense
optionB: the talk had too little content
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: the talk may have been too dense.

promptEs: ¿Qué debe identificar el oyente?
stimulusEn: Could you have sent it to me by the end of the day?
optionB: a request about sending something by a deadline
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: a request about sending something by a deadline.

promptEs: ¿Qué preocupación mantiene el hablante?
stimulusEn: The app collects location only while a trip is active. Even so, users should be told clearly how long those records are kept.
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: data-retention transparency.

promptEs: ¿Qué estructura argumentativa presenta?
stimulusEn: Rent controls can protect existing tenants, while critics argue they may reduce incentives to build new housing.
optionA: a benefit contrasted with a possible cost
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: a benefit contrasted with a possible cost.

promptEs: ¿Qué intenta lograr el gerente?
stimulusEn: I am not saying the report is wrong, but the figures in section three deserve another look before we send it to the client.
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: prompt a careful recheck.

promptEs: ¿Qué función cumple perhaps?
stimulusEn: Perhaps we could revisit that assumption before we commit to the final model.
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: soften a suggestion or challenge.

promptEs: ¿Por qué proponen una prueba temporal?
stimulusEn: The proposal would reduce traffic in the city centre, but businesses worry that fewer drivers could mean fewer customers. The council therefore plans a six-month trial before making the change permanent.
optionA: to evaluate benefits and business concerns
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: to evaluate benefits and business concerns.

promptEs: ¿Qué decisión presenta como compleja?
stimulusEn: Replacing the motor would extend the machine’s life, but the repair costs almost as much as a newer, more efficient unit.
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: repair versus replacement.

promptEs: ¿Por qué pide cautela?
stimulusEn: The two groups differed after the intervention, yet they were not randomly assigned. We should therefore be careful about claiming that the intervention caused the difference.
optionA: the design does not establish causation securely
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: the design does not establish causation securely.

promptEs: ¿Cuál es el punto central?
stimulusEn: The basic plan appears cheaper, whereas the professional plan includes support and storage that we would otherwise purchase separately.
optionA: support and storage have no value
optionB: headline price may not equal total cost
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: headline price may not equal total cost.

promptEs: ¿Qué intención expresa?
stimulusEn: If you have a moment, it might be worth showing the new staff how the backup process works.
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: a polite recommendation.

promptEs: ¿Qué matiz añade el hablante?
stimulusEn: Planting trees can reduce summer heat and improve shade. However, species choice and long-term maintenance determine whether those benefits last.
optionA: any tree always gives the same result
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: implementation affects long-term benefits.

promptEs: ¿Cuál es la idea central?
stimulusEn: A cheaper component would reduce the purchase price by twelve percent. Yet it needs replacement twice as often and requires more maintenance hours. Once those costs are included, the supposedly cheaper option may not save money over the full life cycle.
optionA: the cheapest purchase price always wins
optionB: initial price can differ from life-cycle cost
explanationEs: Interpretación objetivo: initial price can differ from life-cycle cost.

promptEs: ¿Qué debilidad identificaron?
stimulusEn: The model performed well during ordinary weather but underestimated demand during two heat waves. Before using it operationally, the analysts want to retrain it with more extreme events and test whether the improvement generalises.
optionA: poor performance in all normal conditions
explanationEs: Interpretación objetivo: poor performance during extreme heat.

promptEs: ¿Por qué puede ser engañosa la mejora?
stimulusEn: The factory reduced reported downtime by postponing some preventive maintenance. In the short term the figures looked better, but several engineers warned that failures could become more frequent later. The apparent efficiency gain therefore needs to be interpreted cautiously.
optionB: maintenance was postponed rather than eliminated
explanationEs: Interpretación objetivo: maintenance was postponed rather than eliminated.

promptEs: ¿Por qué se usa una prueba de seis meses?
stimulusEn: The city plans to restrict private cars on two central streets for six months. Supporters expect cleaner air and safer walking conditions, while shop owners fear losing customers. Rather than make the change permanent immediately, the council will compare traffic, pollution and sales data before deciding.
optionB: to compare competing effects before a permanent decision
explanationEs: Interpretación objetivo: to compare competing effects before a permanent decision.

promptEs: ¿Qué solución propone el equipo?
stimulusEn: The app can provide more personalised recommendations if it stores detailed usage history. The same data, however, increases privacy risk if access controls fail. The design team proposes keeping only the minimum history needed for adaptation.
explanationEs: Interpretación objetivo: data minimisation.

promptEs: ¿Cuál es la principal cautela?
stimulusEn: Participants who chose to join the training programme improved more than those who did not. That difference is encouraging, but self-selection matters: people who volunteered may already have been more motivated. The result supports further research, not a strong causal claim.
optionB: self-selection may explain part of the difference
explanationEs: Interpretación objetivo: self-selection may explain part of the difference.

promptEs: ¿Cuál es la conclusión del hablante?
stimulusEn: The cheaper sensor looks attractive at first. Nevertheless, it needs calibration twice as often, so its total operating cost may actually be higher.
optionA: the cheaper sensor may cost more over time
optionB: calibration has no effect on cost
explanationEs: El argumento distingue precio inicial de costo total.

promptEs: ¿Qué pregunta hace el hablante?
stimulusEn: What did you want to do after the meeting?
optionA: what action was planned after the meeting
explanationEs: La cadena debe segmentarse pese al habla conectada.

promptEs: ¿Qué contraste aparece?
stimulusEn: Most participants supported the proposal. Even so, several raised concerns about how the data would be stored.
explanationEs: Even so introduce una reserva frente al apoyo general.

promptEs: ¿Qué intenta comunicar principalmente?
stimulusEn: You could submit the report today, but I would check the figures one more time if I were you.
optionA: a cautious recommendation to review the figures
optionB: an order to delete the report
explanationEs: La forma condicional suaviza una recomendación.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión account for.
explanationEs: account for: explicar / representar. Ejemplo: Transport accounts for a large share of the emissions.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión address an issue.
explanationEs: address an issue: abordar un problema. Ejemplo: The revised plan addresses the main privacy issue.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión be subject to.
explanationEs: be subject to: estar sujeto a. Ejemplo: The permit is subject to periodic review.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión bring about.
explanationEs: bring about: provocar / causar. Ejemplo: The new policy brought about several changes.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión by contrast.
explanationEs: by contrast: en cambio. Ejemplo: The first group improved; by contrast, the second remained stable.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión by means of.
explanationEs: by means of: por medio de. Ejemplo: The concentration was estimated by means of a standard method.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión carry out.
explanationEs: carry out: llevar a cabo. Ejemplo: The laboratory carried out three independent tests.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión come up with.
explanationEs: come up with: idear / proponer. Ejemplo: The team came up with a practical solution.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión contribute to.
explanationEs: contribute to: contribuir a. Ejemplo: Several factors contributed to the final result.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión cope with.
explanationEs: cope with: hacer frente a. Ejemplo: The system must cope with sudden changes in demand.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión cut down on.
explanationEs: cut down on: reducir. Ejemplo: We are trying to cut down on unnecessary travel.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión distinguish between.
explanationEs: distinguish between: distinguir entre. Ejemplo: It is important to distinguish between correlation and causation.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión draw a conclusion.
explanationEs: draw a conclusion: sacar una conclusión. Ejemplo: We should not draw a conclusion from one observation.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión figure out.
explanationEs: figure out: averiguar / resolver. Ejemplo: It took us a while to figure out why the sensor failed.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión focus on.
explanationEs: focus on: centrarse en. Ejemplo: The analysis focuses on long-term trends.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión have access to.
explanationEs: have access to: tener acceso a. Ejemplo: Only authorised staff have access to the records.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión in accordance with.
explanationEs: in accordance with: de acuerdo con. Ejemplo: The samples were handled in accordance with the protocol.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión in spite of.
explanationEs: in spite of: a pesar de. Ejemplo: In spite of the delay, the project stayed within budget.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión in terms of.
explanationEs: in terms of: en términos de. Ejemplo: The options differ mainly in terms of cost.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión in the long run.
explanationEs: in the long run: a largo plazo. Ejemplo: The investment should reduce costs in the long run.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión lead to.
explanationEs: lead to: conducir a. Ejemplo: A small error can lead to a larger problem.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión make an assumption.
explanationEs: make an assumption: hacer una suposición. Ejemplo: The model makes an assumption about future demand.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión meet a requirement.
explanationEs: meet a requirement: cumplir un requisito. Ejemplo: The device must meet the legal requirement.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión on the whole.
explanationEs: on the whole: en general / en conjunto. Ejemplo: On the whole, the programme achieved its main objectives.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión play a role in.
explanationEs: play a role in: desempeñar un papel en. Ejemplo: Temperature plays a role in the reaction rate.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión pose a risk.
explanationEs: pose a risk: plantear / suponer un riesgo. Ejemplo: The leak may pose a risk to nearby residents.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión provided that.
explanationEs: provided that: siempre que. Ejemplo: The method is reliable provided that the equipment is calibrated.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión reach a consensus.
explanationEs: reach a consensus: alcanzar un consenso. Ejemplo: The committee eventually reached a consensus.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión refer to.
explanationEs: refer to: referirse a. Ejemplo: The term refers to a specific type of waste.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión rely on.
explanationEs: rely on: depender de / confiar en. Ejemplo: The model relies on several assumptions.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión result in.
explanationEs: result in: dar lugar a. Ejemplo: Poor ventilation can result in higher indoor temperatures.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión rule out.
explanationEs: rule out: descartar. Ejemplo: The evidence does not rule out an alternative explanation.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión take measures.
explanationEs: take measures: tomar medidas. Ejemplo: The company took measures to reduce noise.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión to some extent.
explanationEs: to some extent: hasta cierto punto. Ejemplo: The result can be explained, to some extent, by seasonal variation.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión unless.
explanationEs: unless: a menos que. Ejemplo: The deadline will remain unchanged unless new evidence appears.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión with regard to.
explanationEs: with regard to: con respecto a. Ejemplo: With regard to safety, both designs meet the standard.

promptEs: Escucha este objetivo fonológico: Asimilación.
explanationEs: Rasgo objetivo: Asimilación.

promptEs: Escucha este objetivo fonológico: Entonación y actitud.
explanationEs: Rasgo objetivo: Entonación y actitud.

promptEs: Escucha este objetivo fonológico: Elisión de /t/ o /d/.
explanationEs: Rasgo objetivo: Elisión de /t/ o /d/.

promptEs: Escucha este objetivo fonológico: Grupos entonativos.
stimulusEn: After the meeting | we checked the figures.
explanationEs: Rasgo objetivo: Grupos entonativos.

promptEs: Función pragmática: Crítica diplomática.
stimulusEn: The proposal is promising, although the evidence section could be stronger.
explanationEs: Uso: criticar sin rechazo frontal.

promptEs: Función pragmática: Negociar una solución.
stimulusEn: If we move the deadline, could you provide the missing data by Monday?
explanationEs: Uso: intercambiar concesión y condición.

promptEs: Función pragmática: Reformular para confirmar.
stimulusEn: So, if I understand correctly, your main concern is reliability rather than price.
explanationEs: Uso: verificar comprensión mediante reformulación.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión back up.
explanationEs: back up: respaldar. Ejemplo: The conclusion is backed up by two independent studies.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión brush up on.
explanationEs: brush up on: repasar / refrescar. Ejemplo: I need to brush up on my statistics before the course.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión come down to.
explanationEs: come down to: reducirse a. Ejemplo: The final choice comes down to cost and reliability.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión draw on.
explanationEs: draw on: recurrir a / aprovechar. Ejemplo: The report draws on several years of monitoring data.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión get across.
explanationEs: get across: transmitir una idea. Ejemplo: The speaker got the main point across clearly.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión go over.
explanationEs: go over: revisar. Ejemplo: Let's go over the results one more time.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión hold back.
explanationEs: hold back: contener / frenar. Ejemplo: A lack of funding is holding the project back.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión lay out.
explanationEs: lay out: exponer / disponer. Ejemplo: The introduction lays out the main argument.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión live up to.
explanationEs: live up to: estar a la altura de. Ejemplo: The product did not live up to expectations.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión make up for.
explanationEs: make up for: compensar. Ejemplo: The lower price does not make up for the poor durability.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión reach a conclusion.
explanationEs: reach a conclusion: llegar a una conclusión. Ejemplo: It is too early to reach a firm conclusion.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión sum up.
explanationEs: sum up: resumir. Ejemplo: To sum up, the intervention reduced average travel time.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión take on.
explanationEs: take on: asumir / adquirir. Ejemplo: She took on more responsibility after the promotion.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión weigh up.
explanationEs: weigh up: sopesar. Ejemplo: We need to weigh up the benefits and risks first.

promptEs: ¿Cómo cambia la interpretación?
stimulusEn: At first the savings look impressive. Once deferred maintenance is included, however, much of the apparent efficiency disappears.
optionA: the later information confirms all savings
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: some savings reflect postponed costs.

promptEs: ¿Qué indica if anything aquí?
stimulusEn: If anything, the result should make us less confident in the causal story, not more.
optionA: a correction that strengthens the opposite conclusion
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: a correction that strengthens the opposite conclusion.

promptEs: ¿Cuál es la postura?
stimulusEn: The correlation is remarkably stable across samples. That strengthens the descriptive finding, but it still tells us little about the direction of causality.
optionA: the pattern is robust but causality remains unresolved
optionB: the correlation proves the causal direction
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: the pattern is robust but causality remains unresolved.

promptEs: ¿Qué debe integrar el oyente?
stimulusEn: The opening claim suggests universal improvement. Near the end, though, the speaker notes that two regions actually declined.
optionB: a later exception qualifies the opening generalization
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: a later exception qualifies the opening generalization.

promptEs: ¿Qué comunica premature?
stimulusEn: It would be premature to rule out measurement error, especially given the unusually high variance in the final wave.
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: the conclusion should remain open.

promptEs: ¿Qué limita la conclusión?
stimulusEn: The intervention appears promising, but the follow-up period is too short to know whether the gains will persist.
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: insufficient long-term evidence.

promptEs: ¿Dónde sitúa el cuello de botella?
stimulusEn: Technical capacity is not the binding constraint. Several agencies already have the necessary systems; the unresolved issue is whether they can agree on shared standards.
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: institutional coordination.

promptEs: ¿Qué criterio prioriza?
stimulusEn: What matters here is not whether the model predicts well in the original sample; it is whether that performance survives genuinely new data.
optionA: fit to the original sample only
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: out-of-sample generalization.

promptEs: ¿Cuál es la estructura?
stimulusEn: The author accepts that regulation imposes costs, disputes the estimate of their magnitude, and then argues that the comparison omits avoided damages.
optionA: concession, challenge, then additional countervailing benefit
optionB: unqualified agreement with the cost estimate
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: concession, challenge, then additional countervailing benefit.

promptEs: ¿Cómo evoluciona el argumento?
stimulusEn: The speaker first treats cost as the main objection, then concedes that funding is available, and finally shifts to concerns about implementation capacity.
optionA: the central objection shifts from cost to implementation
optionB: the same objection is repeated unchanged
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: the central objection shifts from cost to implementation.

promptEs: ¿Qué postura adopta?
stimulusEn: The evidence is broadly consistent with the proposed mechanism, though two alternative explanations remain difficult to exclude.
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: qualified support with residual uncertainty.

promptEs: ¿Qué revisa el hablante?
stimulusEn: Earlier I described the effect as small. That was too simple: it is small on average, but substantial for participants who began with the lowest scores.
optionA: an aggregate description using subgroup evidence
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: an aggregate description using subgroup evidence.

promptEs: ¿Qué postura adopta el hablante?
stimulusEn: The intervention coincided with a decline in complaints, and the timing is certainly suggestive. Still, several other changes occurred during the same period, including new staffing rules and a seasonal fall in demand. The evidence is compatible with an effect, but it does not isolate one mechanism convincingly.
optionA: the intervention is proven to be the only cause
optionB: the intervention may matter but causation is not isolated
explanationEs: Interpretación objetivo: the intervention may matter but causation is not isolated.

promptEs: ¿Qué interpretación integra mejor la información?
stimulusEn: At the beginning of the talk, the speaker presents falling operating costs as a success. Much later she notes that investment in maintenance also fell sharply. In the final section she warns that equipment failures have started to rise. Taken together, the details complicate the initial success story.
optionA: lower costs may partly reflect underinvestment with later consequences
explanationEs: Interpretación objetivo: lower costs may partly reflect underinvestment with later consequences.

promptEs: ¿Qué reserva introduce?
stimulusEn: The review identifies a recurring association between exposure and performance, but the studies vary widely in design and measurement. A pooled estimate is informative, provided it is not mistaken for evidence that every context behaves in the same way.
optionA: the average pattern may not hold uniformly across contexts
explanationEs: Interpretación objetivo: the average pattern may not hold uniformly across contexts.

promptEs: ¿Dónde está el principal obstáculo?
stimulusEn: The technology itself has already worked in three pilot sites. What remains uncertain is governance: agencies use different definitions, budgets are approved on different schedules, and no institution has authority to resolve conflicts. Scaling the system therefore depends less on engineering than on coordination.
explanationEs: Interpretación objetivo: institutional coordination.

promptEs: ¿Cuál es la principal limitación?
stimulusEn: The simulation reproduces historical averages remarkably well. Its weakest point is precisely where decision-makers most need guidance: rare disruptions. Because the model has seen few such events, confidence intervals widen sharply under extreme scenarios.
explanationEs: Interpretación objetivo: uncertainty under rare extreme events.

promptEs: ¿Cuál es su postura?
stimulusEn: The author accepts that the regulation improved transparency. She nevertheless questions whether the administrative burden is proportionate for very small organisations, and suggests a simplified route for low-risk cases.
optionB: support for the goal with a qualified criticism of implementation
explanationEs: Interpretación objetivo: support for the goal with a qualified criticism of implementation.

promptEs: ¿Cómo debe interpretarse la caída de costos?
stimulusEn: Early in the presentation, the speaker says costs fell. Much later, she explains that the reduction came mainly from postponing maintenance rather than improving efficiency.
optionA: it may reflect postponed maintenance rather than efficiency
explanationEs: La explicación relevante aparece separada de la afirmación inicial.

promptEs: ¿Qué grado de certeza expresa?
stimulusEn: The pattern may be consistent with a causal effect, although alternative explanations cannot yet be ruled out.
explanationEs: May y cannot yet be ruled out mantienen incertidumbre.

promptEs: ¿Cuál es la postura?
stimulusEn: The association is suggestive, but the evidence is hardly conclusive. At best, it justifies a more targeted study.
explanationEs: Hardly conclusive y at best expresan cautela.

promptEs: ¿Dónde sitúa el problema central?
stimulusEn: The proposal sounds straightforward. The difficulty is not the technology itself. What matters is whether institutions can coordinate their decisions over time.
explanationEs: El hablante desplaza el foco de tecnología a coordinación.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión albeit.
explanationEs: albeit: aunque / si bien. Ejemplo: The intervention produced a modest, albeit measurable, improvement.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión at odds with.
explanationEs: at odds with: en desacuerdo / contradicción con. Ejemplo: The finding is at odds with the earlier survey.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión a matter of.
explanationEs: a matter of: una cuestión de. Ejemplo: The disagreement is partly a matter of interpretation.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión a range of.
explanationEs: a range of: una variedad de. Ejemplo: The framework considers a range of environmental impacts.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión bear in mind.
explanationEs: bear in mind: tener presente. Ejemplo: Bear in mind that the sample was relatively small.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión be attributable to.
explanationEs: be attributable to: ser atribuible a. Ejemplo: Part of the improvement may be attributable to prior training.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión be consistent with.
explanationEs: be consistent with: ser coherente con. Ejemplo: The observed pattern is consistent with the proposed mechanism.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión be indicative of.
explanationEs: be indicative of: ser indicativo de. Ejemplo: A sudden increase may be indicative of a measurement problem.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión be prone to.
explanationEs: be prone to: ser propenso a. Ejemplo: Small sensors can be prone to drift over time.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión by the same token.
explanationEs: by the same token: por la misma lógica. Ejemplo: Costs may rise; by the same token, service quality may improve.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión call into question.
explanationEs: call into question: poner en duda. Ejemplo: The inconsistency calls the original conclusion into question.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión exert influence on.
explanationEs: exert influence on: ejercer influencia sobre. Ejemplo: Institutional rules exert considerable influence on behaviour.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión fall short of.
explanationEs: fall short of: no alcanzar. Ejemplo: The evidence falls short of proving a causal relationship.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión for the most part.
explanationEs: for the most part: en su mayor parte. Ejemplo: For the most part, the participants followed the protocol.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión from this perspective.
explanationEs: from this perspective: desde esta perspectiva. Ejemplo: From this perspective, efficiency is not the only relevant criterion.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión give rise to.
explanationEs: give rise to: dar lugar a. Ejemplo: The change may give rise to unintended consequences.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión hinge on.
explanationEs: hinge on: depender decisivamente de. Ejemplo: The decision hinges on whether the assumptions are realistic.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión insofar as.
explanationEs: insofar as: en la medida en que. Ejemplo: The comparison is useful insofar as the groups are genuinely comparable.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión in keeping with.
explanationEs: in keeping with: de acuerdo con / en consonancia con. Ejemplo: The revised procedure is in keeping with current guidance.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión in light of.
explanationEs: in light of: a la luz de. Ejemplo: In light of the new evidence, the policy should be reviewed.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión in line with.

promptEs: ¿Qué debe inferirse?
stimulusEn: The national average barely moved, yet that stability is deceptive: gains in urban districts almost exactly offset losses in rural ones.
optionB: aggregate stability masks divergent subgroup changes
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: aggregate stability masks divergent subgroup changes.

promptEs: ¿Qué presuposición cuestiona?
stimulusEn: The absence of complaints is not evidence of satisfaction when the very groups most affected have no effective channel through which to complain.
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: that silence reliably indicates satisfaction.

promptEs: ¿Qué debilita la afirmación principal?
stimulusEn: Had the baseline trend continued, the apparent improvement would have occurred even without the intervention; that possibility substantially weakens the headline claim.
optionA: a counterfactual trend that could explain the improvement
optionB: proof that the intervention had no participants
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: a counterfactual trend that could explain the improvement.

promptEs: ¿Cómo responde?
stimulusEn: There is something to that objection, but it assumes the baseline itself is neutral, which is precisely what the historical evidence calls into question.
optionA: concedes part of the objection then challenges its premise
optionB: dismisses the objection without engaging it
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: concedes part of the objection then challenges its premise.

promptEs: ¿Qué comunica efficient?
stimulusEn: After the fourth revision request, he smiled and said, “At least the process is wonderfully efficient.”
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: ironic criticism of inefficiency.

promptEs: ¿Qué implica?
stimulusEn: When asked whether the deadline was realistic, the engineer said, “Well, the calendar certainly has a Friday on it.”
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: skepticism about meeting the deadline.

promptEs: ¿Cuál es la síntesis adecuada?
stimulusEn: The review praises the programme’s reach, questions the reliability of its outcome measures, and recommends expansion only if stronger evaluation is built into the next phase.
optionA: conditional support tied to better evaluation
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: conditional support tied to better evaluation.

promptEs: ¿Cuál es la mejor mediación?
stimulusEn: One source attributes the decline to demand, another to regulation, while the administrative data suggest both mechanisms may operate in different sectors.
optionA: all sources identify exactly the same cause
optionB: the evidence supports a sector-dependent combination of explanations
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: the evidence supports a sector-dependent combination of explanations.

promptEs: ¿Cuál es la síntesis más precisa?
stimulusEn: The paper does not reject the theory outright. Rather, it narrows the circumstances under which the authors believe the theory can plausibly apply.
optionA: the theory is retained but its scope is restricted
optionB: the theory is accepted without qualification
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: the theory is retained but its scope is restricted.

promptEs: ¿Qué implica el comentario?
stimulusEn: Calling the arrangement “temporary” is doing considerable rhetorical work here, given that it has already been renewed five times.
optionA: the label temporary is being questioned
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: the label temporary is being questioned.

promptEs: ¿Qué hace el hablante?
stimulusEn: The claim is defensible only if “success” means short-term uptake; it becomes much harder to sustain if success includes long-term retention.
optionA: shows that the conclusion depends on how success is defined
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: shows that the conclusion depends on how success is defined.

promptEs: ¿Qué hace discursivamente?
stimulusEn: Asked whether the target had been missed, the minister replied that the programme had “created an unprecedented platform for future progress.”
optionA: directly confirms that the target was met
optionB: reframes the question to avoid a direct admission
explanationEs: La interpretación correcta es: reframes the question to avoid a direct admission.

promptEs: ¿Qué muestra el análisis desagregado?
stimulusEn: At the national level the indicator barely changes, which might suggest stability. Disaggregate the same data, however, and two opposing movements emerge: urban values rise sharply while rural values fall. The aggregate average conceals a redistribution rather than an absence of change.
optionB: opposing subgroup trends hidden by the average
explanationEs: Interpretación objetivo: opposing subgroup trends hidden by the average.

promptEs: ¿Cómo debe interpretarse wonderful?
stimulusEn: After receiving the third contradictory instruction of the morning, the analyst smiled and said, “Wonderful. At least the process is perfectly clear now.” The literal wording is positive, but the context and exaggeration signal the opposite evaluation.
explanationEs: Interpretación objetivo: as irony expressing frustration.

promptEs: ¿Qué caracteriza una mediación fiel?
stimulusEn: The first report emphasises economic benefits, whereas the second focuses on ecological risks. A fair synthesis does not average those claims mechanically; it identifies that they evaluate the same project through different criteria and makes the trade-off explicit.
optionA: pretending the two reports say the same thing
optionB: making the differing criteria and trade-off explicit
explanationEs: Interpretación objetivo: making the differing criteria and trade-off explicit.

promptEs: ¿Qué se está replanteando?
stimulusEn: One critic argues that the experiment failed because the expected effect was not statistically significant. Another responds that the study was designed to estimate the size and uncertainty of the effect, not to produce a binary verdict. The disagreement is partly about what question the analysis is supposed to answer.
explanationEs: Interpretación objetivo: the purpose of statistical analysis.

promptEs: ¿Qué supuesto cuestiona?
stimulusEn: The proposal is often presented as a purely technical optimisation, yet choosing what to optimise already embeds a value judgement. A system that minimises average waiting time may still impose very long waits on a small minority. Efficiency and fairness cannot simply be treated as interchangeable objectives.
optionA: that waiting time can be measured
explanationEs: Interpretación objetivo: that technical optimisation is value-neutral.

promptEs: ¿Qué hace retóricamente la respuesta?
stimulusEn: Asked whether the merger had delivered the promised savings, the chair replied that the organisation was now “better positioned for future efficiencies.” The phrase sounds positive, but it quietly shifts attention from realised savings to possible future gains.
optionB: avoids confirming the original claim by reframing it
explanationEs: Interpretación objetivo: avoids confirming the original claim by reframing it.

promptEs: ¿Qué problema describe?
stimulusEn: The apparent consensus dissolves once the categories are disaggregated: what looks stable at the aggregate level masks opposing trends across subgroups.
explanationEs: La afirmación contrasta nivel agregado y subgrupos.

promptEs: ¿Cómo debe interpretarse excellent?
stimulusEn: After the third system failure that morning, she looked at the error message and said, “Excellent. Exactly what we needed.”
explanationEs: El contexto hace incompatible una lectura literal positiva.

promptEs: ¿Cuál es la síntesis más fiel?
stimulusEn: The author accepts the ethical objective but rejects the proposed mechanism, arguing that it would shift costs onto the very population it is intended to protect.
optionA: the goal is accepted but the mechanism is criticized for its distributional effects
optionB: both the goal and mechanism are rejected
explanationEs: La síntesis preserva la concesión y la crítica.

promptEs: ¿Qué sugiere la respuesta?
stimulusEn: When asked whether the reform had succeeded, the director replied, “It has certainly generated a great deal of discussion.”
optionA: the director avoids directly claiming success
optionB: the director gives an unequivocal yes
explanationEs: La respuesta elude la afirmación solicitada y desplaza el criterio.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión all things considered.
explanationEs: all things considered: considerándolo todo. Ejemplo: All things considered, postponing the decision is the safer option.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión beg the question.
explanationEs: beg the question: dar por supuesto lo que debe demostrarse. Ejemplo: Claiming the method is superior because it is better simply begs the question.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión be commensurate with.
explanationEs: be commensurate with: ser proporcional / acorde con. Ejemplo: The response should be commensurate with the level of risk.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión be conducive to.
explanationEs: be conducive to: ser favorable para. Ejemplo: A stable environment is conducive to careful decision-making.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión be contingent on.
explanationEs: be contingent on: depender de. Ejemplo: The recommendation is contingent on the availability of reliable monitoring.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión be detrimental to.
explanationEs: be detrimental to: ser perjudicial para. Ejemplo: Frequent interruptions can be detrimental to sustained attention.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión be emblematic of.
explanationEs: be emblematic of: ser emblemático de. Ejemplo: The dispute is emblematic of a broader conflict over priorities.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión be hard-pressed to.
explanationEs: be hard-pressed to: tener grandes dificultades para. Ejemplo: We would be hard-pressed to justify that conclusion from the available data.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión be predicated on.
explanationEs: be predicated on: basarse en. Ejemplo: The argument is predicated on a distinction that the data do not support.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión be symptomatic of.
explanationEs: be symptomatic of: ser sintomático de. Ejemplo: Repeated delays may be symptomatic of a deeper coordination problem.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión be tantamount to.
explanationEs: be tantamount to: equivaler prácticamente a. Ejemplo: Ignoring the uncertainty would be tantamount to assuming it does not exist.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión be that as it may.
explanationEs: be that as it may: sea como fuere. Ejemplo: Be that as it may, the underlying uncertainty still needs to be addressed.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión by no means.
explanationEs: by no means: de ningún modo. Ejemplo: The absence of complaints is by no means proof that the system is fair.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión by virtue of.
explanationEs: by virtue of: en virtud de. Ejemplo: The site qualifies by virtue of its legal status.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión cast doubt on.
explanationEs: cast doubt on: poner en duda. Ejemplo: The missing records cast doubt on the precision of the estimate.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión far from.
explanationEs: far from: lejos de. Ejemplo: Far from resolving the dispute, the announcement intensified it.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión for all intents and purposes.
explanationEs: for all intents and purposes: a efectos prácticos. Ejemplo: For all intents and purposes, the two versions behave identically.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión for the sake of.
explanationEs: for the sake of: por el bien de / en aras de. Ejemplo: For the sake of clarity, the two mechanisms should be discussed separately.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión for want of.
explanationEs: for want of: por falta de. Ejemplo: For want of better evidence, the estimate was retained provisionally.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión in stark contrast to.
explanationEs: in stark contrast to: en marcado contraste con. Ejemplo: The second period was stable, in stark contrast to the first.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión in the absence of.
explanationEs: in the absence of: a falta de. Ejemplo: In the absence of direct measurements, the estimate remains provisional.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión in the event of.
explanationEs: in the event of: en caso de. Ejemplo: In the event of a power failure, the system switches to backup mode.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión in the wake of.
explanationEs: in the wake of: a raíz de. Ejemplo: The procedure was revised in the wake of the incident.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión leave much to be desired.
explanationEs: leave much to be desired: dejar mucho que desear. Ejemplo: The documentation leaves much to be desired.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión lend credence to.
explanationEs: lend credence to: dar credibilidad a. Ejemplo: The replication lends credence to the original explanation.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión let alone.
explanationEs: let alone: y mucho menos. Ejemplo: The dataset cannot establish causation, let alone explain the mechanism.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión much less.
explanationEs: much less: mucho menos. Ejemplo: The report does not identify a clear trend, much less a definitive cause.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión needless to say.
explanationEs: needless to say: no hace falta decir. Ejemplo: Needless to say, confidential records should not be shared casually.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión not so much X as Y.
stimulusEn: not so much X as Y
explanationEs: not so much X as Y: no tanto X como Y. Ejemplo: The problem is not so much technical as institutional.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión on closer inspection.
explanationEs: on closer inspection: al examinarlo con más detalle. Ejemplo: On closer inspection, the apparent contradiction disappears.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión on the face of it.
explanationEs: on the face of it: a primera vista. Ejemplo: On the face of it, the two results appear incompatible.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión run counter to.
explanationEs: run counter to: contradecir. Ejemplo: The proposal runs counter to the principle stated earlier.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión suffice it to say.
explanationEs: suffice it to say: baste decir. Ejemplo: Suffice it to say that the negotiations were far from straightforward.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión take issue with.
explanationEs: take issue with: discrepar de / objetar. Ejemplo: Several reviewers took issue with the way the evidence was interpreted.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión to the extent that.
explanationEs: to the extent that: en la medida en que. Ejemplo: The policy is effective to the extent that local agencies can enforce it.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión be at odds with.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión be premised on.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión bring to bear.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión err on the side of.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión have a bearing on.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión hold sway.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión lend itself to.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión notwithstanding the fact that.
explanationEs: notwithstanding the fact that: a pesar de que. Ejemplo: Notwithstanding the fact that the sample was small, the pattern was remarkably stable.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión put paid to.
explanationEs: put paid to: poner fin a / frustrar. Ejemplo: The unexpected closure put paid to the original fieldwork plan.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión set against.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión stand to reason.

promptEs: Aprende la expresión strike a balance between.
